documents.name: Fire of Anatolia / Troy
documents.summary: Large-scale Anatolian dance productions combining mass choreography, costume, music and mythic storytelling.
documents.whyWorthwhile: One of Europe’s strongest focused cultural spectacles: unusually large ensemble movement and visual storytelling deliver a major-trip evening with little language friction.

booking.note: Book the exact scheduled production and reconfirm before travelling.

coreExperience.note: Dance, music and visual storytelling carry the performance.

confirm-performance.note: Do not assume a regular nightly show or the ancient Aspendos theatre.
